stem.en:
Every Saturday morning, the old railway station in Dunmore turns into a market. Farmers from nearby villages sell eggs, cheese and fresh bread on the platforms, and a band plays where the ticket office used to be. The trains stopped running twenty years ago, but the town did not want to lose the building. Now the market pays for the roof repairs, and the station is busier than it ever was.

What is the text mainly about?

The kinds of cheese that farmers sell in Dunmore
Why the trains to Dunmore stopped running twenty years ago
A band that plays music in the old ticket office
